data.name: Siege Tank

abilities.name: Large
abilities.text: When this Unit's Leading Model moves, it cannot pass through physical gaps smaller than 3″ wide, regardless of its size. If the Leading Model's path of travel passes through, or any model in this Unit ends its movement on a Size 0 or Size 1 Impassible Terrain piece (excluding Tokens) during any movement action, that terrain piece is immediately removed from the game.

abilities.name: Heavy Plating
abilities.text: When this Unit resolves an Armour Roll, it gains TOUGH (1), provided it does not currently have the SIEGE MODE Status.

abilities.name: Indomitable
abilities.text: While Engaged, this Unit may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy Units. In both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade Roll against those attacks.

abilities.name: Point Blank
abilities.text: While this Unit has the SIEGE MODE Status, it cannot target Enemy Units it is Engaged with.

abilities.name: Aftershock Rounds
abilities.text: When this Unit has the SIEGE MODE Status, its Damage characteristic is treated as equal to the Size characteristic of the current target Unit (to a minimum of 1).

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (4) 3+ effect.

upgrades.name: Mode Transformation
upgrades.text:
The active Unit gains or loses the SIEGE MODE Status.
While this Unit has the SIEGE MODE Status, its Size characteristic is treated as if it was 3.

upgrades.name: Coordinated Strike
upgrades.text: Target a Friendly Non-Engaged Unit on the battlefield (Line of Sight is not required). When this Unit resolves a Ranged Attack using the Shock Cannon weapon profile this Round, it may choose to ignore the weapon's standard Range characteristic. If it does, it may target an Enemy Unit that is Within 8″ of, and Visible to, a model of the selected Friendly Unit, treating that model as the acting model.

upgrades.name: Shaped Blast
upgrades.text: Once per Game. When this Unit declares a Ranged Attack action. If this Unit has SIEGE MODE Status, its weapon gains PINPOINT and LOCKED IN (4).

upgrades.name: Smart Shells
upgrades.text: Once per Game. When this Unit declares a Ranged Attack action. If this Unit has SIEGE MODE Status, its weapon gains INDIRECT FIRE and LONG RANGE (24).

data.note: BT = Blast Template (Core Rules 8.7.6). A weapon with the SIEGE MODE Status keyword can only be used while this Unit has the SIEGE MODE Status.
